protocol.title: Paper Microfluidics Goes Digital
protocol.platform: Paper DMF (digital microfluidics on inkjet-printed silver-on-paper substrates)
protocol.objective: Demonstrate fully automated, complex, multistep reactions on paper-based DMF substrates: (1) on-chip serial dilution and HRP chemiluminescence calibration curve; (2) proof-of-principle rubella IgG sandwich ELISA with magnetic bead separation

device.fabrication_method: Inkjet printing of silver nanoparticle ink on optimized photo paper
device.printer: Dimatix DMP-2800 (FUJIFILM Dimatix, Inc., Santa Clara, CA)
device.sintering: 1500 W infrared lamp at ~1 cm distance for 10 s

Design_A.use: HRP chemiluminescence assay and all other experiments

substrate_types: Custom paper (Bollstrom et al., Org. Electron. 2009, provided by Prof. M. Toivakka, Abo Akademi University)
device.hydrophobic_coating: ~50 nm Teflon-AF 1600 (1% wt/wt in Fluorinert FC-40, 1000 rpm, 30 s, post-baked 160 C 10 min)
device.top_plate: ITO-coated glass coated with 50 nm Teflon-AF
device.controller: Open-source DropBot (with or without integrated magnetic control and PMT)

general.deionized_water: 18 MOhm cm at 25 C (Sigma-Aldrich, Oakville, ON)
general.pluronic_L64: 0.05% v/v added to all HRP/substrate solutions; 0.025% v/v for chemiluminescent substrate (BASF Corp., Germany; donated by Brenntag Canada)
general.notes: Pluronic L64 reduces protein adsorption and limits cross-contamination (ref [30])

assay_1_hrp_chemiluminescence.hrp_standard: 100 uU/mL horseradish peroxidase in DPBS + 0.05% v/v Pluronic L64
assay_1_hrp_chemiluminescence.wash_buffer: DPBS supplemented with 0.05% v/v Pluronic L64
assay_1_hrp_chemiluminescence.chemiluminescent_substrate: SuperSignal ELISA Femto (Thermo Fischer Scientific, Rockford, IL); stable H2O2 + Luminol-Enhancer solution premixed before loading
assay_1_hrp_chemiluminescence.detection_instrument: H10682-110 PMT (Hamamatsu Photonics K.K., Hamamatsu, Japan)

paramagnetic_particles.preparation: Pelleted, washed, resuspended in Superblock Tris-buffered saline (Thermo Fischer Scientific)

assay_2_rubella_elisa.wash_buffer: Custom DMF-compatible wash buffer (as described in refs [25,27])
assay_2_rubella_elisa.chemiluminescent_substrate: SuperSignal ELISA Femto (H2O2 + Luminol-Enhancer) + 0.025% v/v Pluronic L64
assay_2_rubella_elisa.detection_instrument: H10682-110 PMT (Hamamatsu Photonics K.K., Hamamatsu, Japan)
assay_2_rubella_elisa.magnetic_separation: Motorized magnet integrated with DropBot controller (ref [25])

steps.name: Prepare PBS diluent droplets with Pluronic L64
steps.notes: Three independent diluent droplets prepared (one per dilution level). Pluronic L64 at 0.05% v/v added to all reagent solutions to prevent protein adsorption.

steps.name: Dispense HRP standard stock droplets
steps.notes: 100 uU/mL HRP in DPBS + 0.05% v/v Pluronic L64. Three stock drops dispensed from reservoir, one per dilution level.

steps.name: Generate 1x, 2x, and 4x HRP dilution series

4x.notes: 1:4 dilution; 3 diluent units accumulated by explicit chaining (compiler constraint: no multi-unit dispense)

steps.bioscript_note: BioScript has no split-and-reuse construct; serial dilution encoded as explicit dispense+merge chains to avoid stranded-variable compiler errors. All three dilution levels instantiated from fresh manifest dispenses.

steps.name: Merge HRP dilutions with SuperSignal substrate and mix
steps.notes: One SuperSignal substrate drop merged with each diluted HRP drop. Mixed for 60 s on electrode array. Paper M&M: 'pooled drop was mixed for 60 s, driven to the detection area.'

steps.name: Pre-measurement incubation at room temperature
steps.notes: 2 min dwell at ambient temperature in detection zone before PMT readout. Paper M&M: 'emitted light was measured after 2 min with an H10682-110 PMT.'

qc_gate.rationale: 1x (undiluted equivalent) has highest expected HRP concentration and signal

steps.name: Dispense paramagnetic bead suspension
steps.notes: Paper M&M: 'A ca. 1.6 uL drop (2 unit volumes) containing paramagnetic particles was dispensed from a reservoir.' Modelled as two 1-unit dispenses merged to approximate 2-unit-volume drop.

steps.name: Dispense rubella IgG standard and incubate with beads
steps.notes: Paper M&M: 'One drop of rubella IgG standard (0, 1.56 or 3.125 IU/mL) was dispensed, delivered to the immobilized particles, and mixed for 3 min.' Three separate manifest entries used for three IgG concentrations.

steps.name: Primary antibody wash (3x) with magnetic separation
steps.notes: Paper M&M: 'The particles were washed three times in wash buffer and separated from the supernatant.' rubellaMagneticSeparation module abstracts motorized magnet engagement + DMF electrode switching for bead pellet/supernatant separation after each wash cycle.

steps.name: Dispense HRP conjugate and incubate with beads
steps.notes: Paper M&M: 'One drop of HRP conjugate solution was dispensed, delivered to the immobilized particles, and mixed for 2 min.' Conjugate: HRP-conjugated goat anti-human IgG at 16 ng/mL.

steps.name: Post-conjugate wash (3x) with magnetic separation
steps.notes: Paper M&M: 'The particles were washed three times in wash buffer [after conjugate incubation].' Identical wash/separate sequence as B3.

steps.name: Resuspend beads in H2O2 and merge with luminol-enhancer
steps.notes: Paper M&M: 'The particles were separated from the wash buffer and resuspended in one drop of H2O2, and this drop was merged and mixed with one drop of luminol-enhancer solution.' SuperSignal ELISA Femto components loaded separately in BioScript to reflect two-component merge.

qc_gate.rationale: 3.125 IU/mL is the highest tested concentration with highest expected chemiluminescent signal

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: HRP assay: Pluronic+PBS diluents, HRP stock dispense, 1x/2x/4x dilution merge, SuperSignal substrate merge, 60s mix, 2min heat, PMT detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose HRP signals; Rubella ELISA: all 3 concentrations (bead load, IgG incubate, 3x wash, conjugate, 3x wash, H2O2+luminol, 2min heat, PMT detect)

results.drop_velocity_comparison: Nearly identical to glass DMF devices at same actuation voltage
